en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Umar Bin Aban, from Isa Bin Abu Mansour, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It is an Obligation for the Momin upon the Momin that he advises him’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from ‘Umar ibn Aban from ‘Isa ibn abu Mansur from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
It is of a believer’s obligations to provide good advice to another believer.”
